parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of stainless steel. It is a slender rod-like component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of stainless steel. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the wearer’s head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.material: Polycarbonate (for lenses) and Metal (for frame bridge)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, consisting of the lenses and the connecting bridge frame. The lenses are made of polycarbonate, while the bridge is metallic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position for vision correction or protection and connects both legs through the bridge.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central structural component to which the legs are hinged.
